sites.why: Rule 8: planning Agent() construction (OpenAI Agents SDK, counted like a LangChain chat-model construction) uses the vendor default endpoint (no base_url override) with the operator's OPENAI_API_KEY from zillion_config, and resolves its model at runtime to zillion_config['OPENAI_MODEL'] or DEFAULT_AGENT_MODEL='gpt-5.4', a Router catalog id.

production.source: zillion/core.py:448 OPENAI_MODEL="gpt-5.4" is the default app-config value used when no config file/env override is set (matches examples/sample_config.yaml:14 and docs/markdown/readme_contents.md:185 'By default Zillion uses gpt-5.4'); no base_url/client override exists in zillion/agent.py so the OpenAI Agents SDK talks to its default host, api.openai.com.
